items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: I guess you've heard of Lewis Joy.

ctx.x: Now, these shows would play these various cities every year. Both shows would play. Like one would come in, maybe play the early part of the year. One would come in and play -- and usually -- sometimes they would play a little bit after the crops had -- you know what I mean -- come through and the people would have a little money, see.
And there was one show that had a little young saxophonist and clarinetist named Lewis Joy. I guess you've heard of Lewis Joy. Louis Jordan.
